videos.overview: The episode opens with a splendid performance by the Super Singer stars, who dedicate it to the judges Mano, Chitra and Shubha. Arjun, Sri Hari, Anil, Akash, Robin and Monica perform in the introduction round. The judges appreciate their effort and encourage them to do better.

videos.overview: The episode begin's with Anusha's performance. The junior stars, Ajith, Anu, Rakshita, Gautam and Akhilesh entertain the audience with a rock and roll performance. The introduction round continues with a performance from Karthika which is followed by Sharan, Mohammad Arshad, Jessica and Pravasthi's performances.

videos.title: Favourite songs round
videos.overview: This episode, hosted by Anand and Bhavana, showcase contestants singing their favourite songs released after 2006. Mr Ananth Vaidyanathan is invited on the show. Pravasthi is the first performer of the day, followed by Jessica, Saran, Sonika and Sri Hari.

videos.title: Western dance  round
videos.overview: The episode begins with a splendid performance by Spoorthi, followed by Rohini. Contestants Aishwarya and Rohini entertain the audiences with a western dance performance. Next to perform are Angeline, Anal Akash and Krishna Sai. Hosts Bhavana and Anand bring the episode to a fun-filled end.

videos.title: Hari Priya's splendid performance
videos.overview: Contestant Haripriya kickstarts this episode with a stunning performance. Judge Mano entertains the audience with jokes and riddles. The show continues with performances by Anusha, Karthika and Mohammad Arshad.

videos.title: Srisha's rocking performance
videos.overview: The episode begins with Robin's performance. Anand entertains the audience by asking riddles to the contestants. Srisha puts up a rocking performance and is joined by her father towards the end for a dance. The show continues with performances from Nasim, Senthil Nathan, Aishwarya and Monica.

videos.title: Priya's awesome performance
videos.overview: Hosts Anand and Bhavana welcome the first contestant, Priya, on the stage to perform. The next contestant, Sunandha, sings a melodious song and impresses the judges. Mano offers chocolates and food to Bharath for his splendid performance. Shivani and Kumudhini continue. The episode ends with Nasim’s elimination.

videos.title: The freestyle week
videos.overview: Hosts Anand and Priyanka dress up as a cop and a lawyer respectively, to entertain the audience. The judges for the week are Mano, Shubha, Ananth Vaidyanathan and special judge Vijay Praksh. Rohini kickstarts the freestyle week, followed by performances from Sunandha, Kumudhini, Robin and Srisha.

videos.overview: In this episode, Ananth Vaithyanathan introduces contestants Saran, Srihari, Anal Akash and Jessicca. The contestants sing freestyle songs and receive a feedback from the judges.
